get.description: Lists active API keys of the caller in the active organization

post.description: Creates an API key; the secret is returned only in this response

delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's API keys

get.description: Returns one application; the deploy key is shown as its public half only

delete.description: Deletes an application; requires the admin role

patch.description: Changes name, description, source or deployment strategy; requires the developer role

post.description: Replaces the deploy key of an SSH Git source; the old key stops working once removed from the repository

get.description: Lists the most recent deployments of an application, newest first

post.description: Queues a deployment of the application's current source; requires the developer role

get.description: Lists the domains routed to an application and whether this server runs the proxy

post.description: Routes a host name to the application; HTTPS uses a Let's Encrypt certificate and redirects plain HTTP

delete.description: Stops routing a domain to the application

get.description: Resolves the domain and compares it with this server's public address; Cloudflare proxied records are recognised
Returns the signed-in user with organization memberships

post.description: Signs in with email and password and sets an HttpOnly session cookie

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

post.description: Ends the current session and clears the session cookie

get.description: Returns one deployment with its current status

post.description: Cancels a queued deployment immediately or stops a running one

get.description: Returns deployment output from a byte offset; call again with next_offset to follow

post.description: Queues a new deployment that runs the image of this earlier successful deployment

get.description: Containers on this server, running only unless all=true; requires the admin role

post.description: Starts, stops or restarts a container by id or name; requires the admin role

get.description: Docker engine version on this server; requires the admin role

post.description: Creates an application from a Git repository or an image; requires the developer role. SSH repositories get a generated deploy key

get.description: Liveness and database readiness of the control plane
Lists projects of the active organization with their environments

post.description: Creates a project with a production environment; requires the developer role

get.description: Returns one project with its environments

delete.description: Deletes a project and its environments; requires the admin role

patch.description: Renames a project or changes its description; the slug stays fixed

get.description: Lists applications in every environment of a project

post.description: Adds an environment to a project; requires the developer role

delete.description: Deletes an environment; the last environment of a project cannot be deleted

get.description: Reports whether the first owner account still has to be created

post.description: Creates the first owner and organization, then signs the owner in
